name: Authority Model — Receipts and Evidence Chains
description: Define the authority model: receipt schemas, evidence chain structure, capability ontology, approval gate taxonomy, durable ACK contract, identity-bound action semantics, and replayability guarantees. The doctrinal foundation for all authority subsystems.
purpose: Define what must be proven before any subsystem can claim completion. Receipts, evidence chains, and authority binding semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: ADRs define receipt schema, evidence chain, and capability ontology
Authority binding contract specifies durable-before-ACK invariant
Receipt types cover all terminal work outcomes
Evidence chain supports replayability and cross-instance verification
